metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel scheduled analytics rules for the Nutanix_CL custom table. Covers both security/audit detections and operational/availability alerts. Alert-severity-based rules fire only on 'critical' and 'warning'. Deploy after table.json + the collector are live.
Name of the Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace.
Set false to deploy the rules disabled (review before they create incidents).

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Critical or Warning alert raised
properties.description: A Nutanix Prism alert with severity critical or warning was ingested. Surfaces cluster-level problems for triage.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "alert"
| where tolower(Severity) in ("critical", "warning")
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Repeated failed audit operations by a user
properties.description: Five or more failed Nutanix audit operations by the same user within the lookback window. May indicate credential misuse, brute force, or automation with bad credentials.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where tolower(Severity) == "failed"
| summarize FailedCount = count(), Operations = make_set(OperationType, 10), Messages = make_set(Message, 5), StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by ActorUser, NutanixClusterName
| where FailedCount >= 5
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Identity or security configuration change
properties.description: Create/update/delete audit operation targeting identity or security objects (users, roles, directories, certificates, auth/policy). Tracks privilege and security-posture changes.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where OperationType in~ ("CREATE", "UPDATE", "DELETE")
| where tolower(SourceEntityType) has_any ("user", "role", "directory", "cert", "auth", "identity", "idp", "saml", "ldap", "policy")
    or Message has_any ("role", "permission", "password", "certificate", "directory service", "authentication", "LDAP", "SAML")
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName

properties.description: Delete or destructive audit operation (delete, power-off, destroy, migrate, evacuate, reset) against a VM, host, cluster, or storage object. Potential impact / sabotage.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where tolower(SourceEntityType) has_any ("vm", "host", "cluster", "storage_container", "volume_group")
| where OperationType in~ ("DELETE")
    or Message has_any ("delete", "power off", "power_off", "destroy", "remove", "migrate", "evacuate", "shutdown", "reset")
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName

properties.description: Critical or warning Nutanix alert relating to availability, storage, data protection, capacity, hardware, or network. Operational health signal.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "alert"
| where tolower(Severity) in ("critical", "warning")
| where tostring(RawPayload.classifications) has_any ("availability", "storage", "data protection", "capacity", "hardware", "network")
    or Message has_any ("unreachable", "down", "degraded", "offline", "disconnected", "space", "failed disk", "fan", "temperature", "power supply")
| extend HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName

properties.description: No Nutanix_CL records ingested in over 2 hours. Indicates the collector, scheduled task, credentials, or network path to Prism has failed.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
| extend GapMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastSeen)
| where GapMinutes > 120
